a.lede: The Technical University of Denmark (DTU) says information belonging to up to 200,000 users may have been exposed after hackers accessed its identity and access management system and downloaded a large amount of data. [...]
a.title: Danish university DTU breach exposes data of up to 200,000 people

b.lede: The Danish government said the breach of names, addresses, and state-issued ID numbers affects 8 million people, including people living abroad and the deceased.
b.title: Hackers steal 8 million citizens’ records from Danish government database
